topic: Digital screen impression calculation fixes and plan
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in digital screen impression reporting, particularly concerning dwell-time calculations. Initial issues included impressions for digital screens failing to calculate correctly at night and general data inconsistencies due to changes in Inventory parameters.

**Key Findings & Decisions:**
*   Impressions previously approved by Brazil were based on incorrect dwell-time; correct calculation suggests higher impression counts.
*   The team decided to recalculate historical data starting from October 3rd using the old SQL method to ensure reported numbers remain similar to pre-October 3rd figures, minimizing disruption.
*   A new release was deployed fixing data for the last week (starting Oct 3rd) in both SP 75 and SP 120 models. This fix did not alter data prior to October 3rd.
*   The team agreed to use a fixed dwell-time based on a specific period (e.g., August or Sept 26th) for stability, rather than dynamic calculations.
*   Future improvements involving correct dwell-time calculation are planned for release in late November/December, allowing Brazil to see the difference and adopt the accurate version from January 1st.
decisions: Recalculate historical data starting Oct 3rd using old SQL method.
Deploy fixed data for the last week (starting Oct 3rd) in SP 75 and SP 120 models.
Use a stable, fixed dwell-time based on a specific period rather than dynamic calculations.
Delay full release of correct dwell-time calculation until January 1st.
action_items: Monitor the new night recalculation model for proper function.
Determine and communicate the plan to Brazil regarding the corrected dwell-time calculation.
